notes: Boons now come from boon XP instead of after every wave. Every foe you snuff and every lantern upgrade you buy adds a little, and each level takes more XP than the last. A pick opens between waves, and the new Boons button in a run shows your progress and every boon you have.

Balance: foes drop about 15% less gold than 0.18.0 and wave-clear gold is lower. Foes get tougher faster after wave 5 and in deeper worlds (+35% health per depth instead of +30%). Path upgrades and ascensions cost about 20% more.

Camp upgrades cost more, especially at high levels, and the strongest ones are toned down: Whetstone +4% damage per level, Bellows +3% fire rate, Deep purse +3% gold, Thrift −1.5%, Armor breaker −4%, Wave tithe +2 gold, Kindling +20 gold. Runs now start with 100 gold.
New camp upgrade: Boon scholar, +8% boon XP per level.
The shop now shows six featured skins that change every hour, and 36 new shop-only skins (a Legendary, Mythic and Celestial for every lantern) join the rotation.
Hallow’s Eve event shop: 12 new Event skins, one for every lantern, plus the Hallow’s Eve menu theme. Buy them one by one or get the whole set for 450 moonstones.
Event skins now have full Exotic-level effects plus their own: circling bats, drifting ghosts, a blood-moon halo and a flickering jack-o’-lantern glow.
Animated rarity borders now loop smoothly instead of jumping.
Fixed foes getting stuck at the top-left corner of the board, which could stop a wave from ever ending.
title: The Witching Hour
